description: Screenshot of a Getty Images / Patrick McMullan Archives photo page showing four people posing outside a stone building at the Brant Foundation Study Center in Greenwich, Connecticut, on May 15, 2010, at an exhibition preview of Urs Fischer's 'Oscar the Grouch'. The Getty caption identifies them left to right as Matt Rothschild, Rachel Chandler, Adam McEwen and Brianna Lance. Red boxes have been drawn around the faces of the first two figures and the names 'Matt Rothschild, Rachel Chandler' are underlined in red — annotations added by whoever shared the screenshot, highlighting the Rothschild-Chandler pairing emphasized in Q threads.
